headline: OpenAI reveals new safety measures for long-horizon AI models, addressing critical deployment challenges.

items.title: Safety and alignment in an era of long-horizon models
items.summary: OpenAI recently disclosed insights into deploying long-running AI models, focusing on new safety risks and observed failures. By iteratively deploying these models, they have enhanced safeguards to mitigate potential issues. This approach aims to address challenges associated with the extended operation of AI systems, ensuring their alignment with intended goals and minimizing unintended consequences.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding and addressing safety in long-horizon models is crucial for developers to ensure reliable AI system deployment.

items.title: Custom OS installation now available on AWS DeepRacer devices
items.summary: AWS has released a new bootloader for DeepRacer devices, allowing developers to install custom operating systems. This update extends the lifespan and capabilities of the hardware by enabling the use of the latest OS versions, enhancing customization and performance.

items.title: Build specialized agent workflows with Amazon Quick and NVIDIA NeMo
items.summary: Amazon Quick, in conjunction with NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit, now facilitates the creation of customized agent workflows. This integration allows for enhanced business process automation, exemplified by a supply-chain risk management scenario, which streamlines decision-making through guided recommendations.

items.title: Introducing Cosmos 3 Edge
items.summary: Hugging Face announced the release of Cosmos 3 Edge, a new development in their platform aimed at improving edge computing capabilities for AI applications.

items.title: PlanFlip: Attacking Multi-Agent LLM Systems via Planning-Phase Prompt Injection
items.summary: A new study identifies the planning phase of multi-agent LLM systems as a critical attack surface. The research demonstrates how a single prompt injection can compromise the goal decomposition process, highlighting significant security vulnerabilities in agent planning systems.

all_items.summary: OpenAI shares lessons from deploying long-running AI models, highlighting new safety risks, observed failures, and improved safeguards through iterative deployment.

Custom OS installation now available on AWS DeepRacer devices
all_items.summary: With the stock firmware and software, developers couldn't modify their AWS DeepRacer devices to use the latest operating systems. Now, developers can upgrade or install a custom operating system (OS) by using a newly released bootloader, which extends the life of these hardware devices. In this post, we introduce the bootloader, discuss how to use it, and share links to a community distribution that uses it.

We use the NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit to build a supply-chain risk example that helps a planner move from an Amazon Quick dashboard and knowledge context to a guided mitigation recommendation.
